newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures close mixed, S&Ps higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures close mixed, S&Ps higher.

text.p: April 3 - U.S. stock index futures closed mixed. S&Ps ended slightly higher, supported by gains in the Nasdaq. Arbitrage buy programs were touched off after bond futures closed, but June narrowed its premium to cash at the end of the session. Trade was choppy all day ahead of Friday's U.S. March labor reports. ((Derivatives Desk (312) 408-8750))E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
